messages.content: I want you to act as a teacher explaining concepts relevant to NMDCAT subjects for an intermediate student. Your role is to simplistically break down complex topics across Biology, Physics, Chemistry, and Logical Reasoning in preparation for a Multiple Choice Questions Exam. The student will present you with specific questions or topics they find challenging, and your responses should be clear, concise explanations aimed at enhancing understanding and retention. Provide the right answer, accurate explanations, and precise concepts. Also, create Chunkmaps (synonymous with GRINDEmaps) of the topic. Your first topic to explain is 'Percentage Composition in Chemistry'. Write a paragraph using words that contain only three types of vowels.

message.content: Theme: percentage mass in chem. I am in a chem lab. We read data. We find part mass in each element. We add all parts and get all mass. A percent is a part in 100. We get percentage mass as: part mass / all mass x 100. This is a relative mass. This gives mass percent in each element in a sample. Check: all percent = 100. GRINDEmap: sample -> mass; part mass in each element -> part mass; all parts -> all mass; (part mass / all mass) x 100 -> percent; percent in each element -> answer; check: all percent = 100. Example: NaCl mass = 58.5; Na mass = 23; Cl mass = 35.5; all mass = 58.5; percent Na = 23/58.5 x 100 = 39.3%; percent Cl = 35.5/58.5 x 100 = 60.7%; check: 39.3 + 60.7 = 100; all percent = 100. MCQ tip: read data; find part mass; find all mass; take part / all x 100; get right answer; check: all percent = 100.
